entities.summary: Bohdan Mykhaylovych Danylyshyn is a Ukrainian statesman, politician, economist, Doctor of Economic Sciences, Professor, and Academician of the National Academy of Sciences of Ukraine. He is also a Minister of Economy of Ukraine in the second government of Yulia Tymoshenko.
